data.name: Hail of Arrows
data.description: In lieu of his regular attacks, %2 per day an arcane archer of 8th level or higher can fire an arrow at each and every target within range, to a maximum of %1 targets. Each attack uses the archer's primary attack bonus, and each enemy may only be targeted by a single arrow.|HailArrowsTargets|HailArrowsTimes
